describe: The image shows a dark round hole, a soft-edged black disc about two-thirds of the way across, sitting on a cool grey-blue surface. The hole is almost pure black at its centre, with a dark rim that fades into the blue-grey around it. The surface around it is smooth, lightly mottled blue-grey and fairly even in brightness, with slightly lighter tones to the lower left and upper right. The lighting is flat with no strong highlights.
